pages.text: A mighty spirit of flame, wielding two fiery scimitars in strong, heavy cuts. During the fight against the Serpon battle group you were fascinated by these powerful spirits, and after a while studying similar elemental beings you summoned a Flamoar servant of your own.

You can summon this warrior by ritual, or quickly call a Flamoar to your aid with a $(l:supreme/items/blazing_spirit_focus)Blazing Spirit Focus$().$(br)Use $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Fire Charge$() on your Flamoar servant to heal it.
